pages.title: Nether Star
pages.text: Dropped by the $(thing)Wither$(). A power source that never runs dry.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Collect three Wither Skeleton Skulls from Nether Fortresses and summon the Wither somewhere you don't mind wrecking. Big Cannons and autocannons work well from a bunker. Summon it again for more stars.
